evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds root 54100 and preserves the title 'Blood Slayer' with the heading 'Choose a Task'.
The interface exposes Monster hunter (PvM), Boss hunter (PvM), Bounty hunter (PK), Slaughter (PK), 'Get a blood slayer task', reward points, Blood slayer points and Slayer points.
The class is a self-contained interface builder for selecting Blood Slayer task categories and viewing points; no unrelated service role is present.

candidates.note: Name follows the exact visible Blood Slayer title and complete task-selection/reward-point interface role.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 preserves the literal title '@or1@Boss Teleportation Network' in the 604xx interface family.
The builder owns Name of Boss, Bosses, Description, Possible drops and rewards, and a numbered Teleport #1.. selection list whose actions are 'Select this teleport'.
The complete class is one boss catalogue/detail/teleport-selection presentation surface and is constructed by the central interface registry.

candidates.note: Name uses the exact visible Boss Teleportation Network title.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds the 60600-series event-chest interface with Tier I/II prize panels, Roll, Exchange, roll/token progress, Enter next tier, Event Guide and reset controls.
The interface preserves 'Tier I - @yel@Halloween Event 2020' and the same 606xx widgets/fountain event resources consumed by the already-reviewed Halloween Event Chest overlay/handler subsystem.

R130 HalloweenEventChestOverlay and HalloweenEventChestOverlayPacketHandler operate on this exact 606xx widget family, while R317's event-chest widget callback targets widget 60612 from the same interface.

candidates.note: Name completes the already-reviewed Halloween Event Chest overlay/handler/callback subsystem by naming its root interface builder.
